description: This is a test script for a memcached server implementation, including classes for memcache data entries, the memcache database, and the server handler handling asyncio connections. It contains embedded server logic and command handling for memcached commands, primarily for testing or development purposes.

classes.name: MemcacheEntry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry with flags, expiration, data, and CAS identifier.

classes.name: MemcacheDB
classes.description: Implements a memcached-like in-memory key-value store supporting basic operations and expiration.

classes.name: MemcachedHandler
classes.description: Handles incoming asyncio streams, parsing memcached commands and interacting with the MemcacheDB instance.

methods.name: typing.Optional[float] _ttl(value: bytes)
methods.description: Converts expiration bytes to a timestamp or None if not applicable.
